name: Kurokami Kyonyuu Iinchou to Souta-kun no Natsuyasumi
original_name: 黒髪巨乳委員長と草汰くんのなつやすみ
source:

Involving  Shiori, he forces them to walk around naked in the residential area, and makes them go into the convenience store. They are truly doing whatever he says...!?
